entries.zh: 上士在点名前核对了名册。

entries.en: The sale brought little financial gain after expenses.
entries.zh: 扣除费用后，这笔交易几乎没有带来经济收益。

entries.en: The chair consulted a handbook of parliamentary law.
entries.zh: 主席查阅了一本议事规则手册。

entries.en: The news reader corrected the name before continuing.
entries.zh: 新闻播音员更正了名字后继续播报。

entries.en: They will rope off the wet section of the path.
entries.zh: 他们会用绳子隔开小路上潮湿的那一段。

entries.en: The poet described an aestival evening beside the lake.
entries.zh: 诗人描写了湖边的一个夏日傍晚。

entries.en: Some snails aestivate during the hottest part of the year.
entries.zh: 有些蜗牛在一年中最热的时期夏眠。

entries.en: The zoology lecture included a section on aestivation.
entries.zh: 动物学课有一节介绍夏眠。

entries.en: The enlarged image is a hundred times as wide as the original.
entries.zh: 放大后图像的宽度是原图的一百倍。

entries.en: The hockey goalkeeper adjusted an arm guard before practice.
entries.zh: 曲棍球守门员在训练前调整了护臂。

entries.en: Type the file name on the command line.
entries.zh: 在命令行中输入文件名。

entries.en: She carved the white meat from the roasted bird.
entries.zh: 她从烤好的禽鸟上切下了胸部白肉。

entries.en: A side drum marked the rhythm of the march.
entries.zh: 一面小鼓打出了进行曲的节奏。

entries.en: The estate records include a receipt for death duty.
entries.zh: 遗产档案中有一张遗产税收据。
